    Matrix(int n_) : n(n_), a(n_+1, std::vector<int>(n_+1, 0)) {}
    void init() {

            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)

    }
    void set() {
        init();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) a[i][i] = 1;
    }

        }
        return res;

    for (int i = k-2; i >= 0; --i) sums[0][i] = sums[0][i+1] * f[0][i];
    for (int i = 1; i < cnt; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {

        sums[i][k-1] = f[i][k-1];
        for (int j = 1; j < k; ++j) sump[i][j] = f[i][j] * sump[i][j-1];
        for (int j = k-2; j >= 0; --j) sums[i][j] = sums[i][j+1] * f[i][j];
